configuration.caption: Configuration
configuration.title: nxt Configuration
configuration.coolantMistPulseHint: Air blast stays on; mist output cycles on/off
configuration.coolantRelayReserved: Motor/VFD relay output is reserved — do not assign coolant or aux to the same gpOut (energizing it via M7/M8 could power the drives).
configuration.outputGpHint: Select a named board pin (Mist, Coolant, Relay, Aux, …). Clear to unassign. Pins already used by another role are shown disabled.
configuration.outputRoleConflict: {role} already uses this pin — clear that role first, or pick another pin.
configuration.customTravelHint: Required when Platform is Custom (XYZ). Optional A fields: fill a complete A set or leave A blank. Saved to nxt-user-vars.g; overlays go to 0:/sys/nxt-user-custom/ (survives plugin ZIP reinstall). Save also regenerates home*.g.
configuration.customEndstopsHint: Select one or more endstop pins per axis (order matches dual-drive order for M574 P"pin1+pin2"). Pins used by another axis are disabled. Min homes negative; Max homes positive. Overrides apply from nxt-user-custom after the board pack.
configuration.customDrivesHint: Physical drive indices per axis (colon-separated for dual drives). Overrides board M584 via nxt-user-custom/drives-overlay.g.
configuration.customDriveDirsEmpty: Map drives above to configure M569 direction per physical drive.
configuration.rgbLedIndexHint: Addressable LED strip from M950 L in config.g
configuration.globalsSnapshotIntro: Expected nxt global variables from nxt.g / nxt-vars.g and their current values from the live RRF object model. Large vectors are summarized.
configuration.boardBootstrapHint: Bootstrap Auto: Save Configuration creates 0:/sys/nxt-board-bootstrap.requested so the pack loads after nxt-user-vars.g at boot. Bootstrap Off: Save removes that file. Use nxt-board-bootstrap.skip to hard-disable. Override with 0:/sys/nxt-user-board.g (see nxt-user-board.g.example).
configuration.boardMismatch: Board profile override does not match the primary board shortName from the object model. Clear the override to follow the machine, or verify wiring.
configuration.boardVoltageMissing: This board pack requires motor supply 24 V or 48 V. Choose a value below or set global nxtBoardMotorVoltage in nxt-user-vars.g.
configuration.boardNoKitsPlatform: No vendored kits for this platform yet.
configuration.boardPinmapHint: Optional file for M950 overrides; edit on SD or extend in a future UI release.
configuration.boardLoadOrderHint: Boot: nxt-vars → (Custom: nxt-custom-globals) → nxt-user-vars → board pack → nxt-boot → plugins → RGB → nxt-user-overrides (last) → nxtLoaded. Homing is deploy-only to 0:/sys/ — see docs/NXT_BOARD_HOMING.md.
configuration.boardHomingDocHint: Homing axis requirements per platform: docs/NXT_BOARD_HOMING.md
configuration.boardDeployOnPlatformChange: Apply homing/sys files for platform {platform} now? Will overwrite: {files}

calibration.caption: Calibration
calibration.intro: 1-2-3 block orientation: 3″∥X, 2″∥Y, 1″∥Z (25.4×50.8×76.2 mm). Enter measured values; review before Apply. Save writes user-vars and, on Custom, regenerates nxt-user-custom overlays (steps.g / drives-overlay.g).
calibration.blockOrientation: Place the 1-2-3 block with the 3″ edge parallel to machine X, 2″ along Y, and 1″ as height (Z). Same orientation for A-axis work on the rotary.
calibration.needConnection: Connect to the machine to apply and save calibration.
calibration.phase0Hint: Touch probe is configured but reference location or nxtDeltaMachine is unset. Install a datum tool, run M5016 (toolsetter + reference surface), then park and load the probe tool so tpost runs G6511. Save to make permanent.
calibration.phase0BlocksProbe: Finish Phase 0 datum setup before probe-assisted calibration (M5015 / G9000).
calibration.probeModeHint: Calibrate deflection first, then run 8 / 16 / 24 mm travel tests (probe → away → re-probe, 3× per leg). Near-constant error → backlash; near-proportional → steps/mm.
calibration.deflectionGateHint: Probe deflection is not confirmed for this session. Complete Phase 4 or confirm the saved value before G9000.
calibration.deflectionRecheckHint: Steps/mm changed — re-check probe deflection (Phase 4) before Save is complete.
calibration.confirmZeroDeflection: Saved deflection is 0. Use 0 and continue?
calibration.runG9000Confirm: Run G9000 on {0}? Jog near a 1-2-3 face (3″∥X). Each leg probes, travels away, re-probes — 3 repeats.
calibration.rotaryHint: Requires MosFourthAxis and a visible A axis. Keep the 1-2-3 block with 3″ parallel to machine X on the rotary. Use M4912/M4910/M4807; apply A steps via M4806 (not raw M92 A).
calibration.phase1Hint: Block: 3″∥X. Pick which face you are on; travel is away from that face. Zero the dial on the surface, then the machine runs 8 / 16 / 24 mm away and back. Enter residual after each return.
calibration.residualSignHint: Residual sign: + = short of zero after return (gap). measured = commanded − residual.
calibration.runMotionTestHint: Machine prompts: zero dial → away/return for 8, 16, 24 mm → enter residual each cycle. Results classify like probe mode.
calibration.runMotionTestConfirm: Run M5014 on {0} (away dir {1})? Zero the dial when prompted, then enter residuals on the machine.
calibration.phase2Hint: Keep 3″∥X. Face-pair defaults follow the axis (X: 2″+3″, Y/Z: 1″+2″). Probe each size and capture measured values; constant offsets cancel.
calibration.runG6512JogHint: M5015: jog to the block face (3″∥X), probe to the target (may be negative), back off, then return to the approach position.
calibration.phase3Hint: Probe a 1-2-3 face from both directions (block still 3″∥X). Enter means or capture samples from nxtLastProbeResult.
calibration.phase4Hint: With steps and backlash set, probe across the axis primary face (X→3″, Y→2″, Z→1″); deflection = (measured − nominal) / 2.
calibration.phase5Hint: Re-check 1-2-3 faces (3″∥X), backlash, and repeatability. Save when satisfied.

probingCycles.title: Probing Cycles
probingCycles.wcsHint: WCS1–WCS9 (G54⋯G59.3). Matches U / M6520 W; jog macros use workplace index W−1.
probingCycles.selectCycle: Select a probing cycle to configure and execute
probingCycles.touchProbeWarning: Touch probe feature must be enabled to use probing cycles.
probingCycles.selectProbeTool: Touch probe (T{0}) must be selected to run probing cycles.
probingCycles.guidedJogHint: Operator prompts and jog dialogs (Jake execute stack via *-jog macros)

maintenance.caption: Maintenance
maintenance.idleEnable: Dim RGB and lower fan after inactivity

toolManagement.caption: Tool Library
toolManagement.libraryIntro: Tools defined in the RepRapFirmware object model (configured slots, the tool in the spindle, and the configured touch probe). Magazine, job sequence, and ATC controls belong in the mos-atc plugin when installed.
toolManagement.persistenceHint: Save to board writes /sys/nxt-user-tools.g (M4000 + G10 L1). After each successful M4000 or M4001, the board also runs nxt-user-tools-sync.g to refresh that file unless you set global nxtAutoPersistTools = false in nxt-user-vars.g. Use Reload from SD after a manual SD edit. Boot loads this file after nxt-user-vars.g.
toolManagement.saveToBoardSuccess: Tool library saved to {path}. Restart the machine or tap Reload from SD to apply immediately.
toolManagement.reloadFromSdFailed: Failed to reload tool library from SD
toolManagement.lockedHint: Tool table is locked — unlock to add, edit, delete, or import tools.
toolManagement.indexProbeReserved: That index is reserved for the probe
toolManagement.importFusionHint: Choose an exported Fusion .tools file (ZIP with tools.json). User pockets are capped at T0–T48 on a 50-tool table; the probe slot is skipped.
toolManagement.importEmpty: No importable tools found in that file.
toolManagement.noTools: No configured tools in the object model yet. Define tools in config.g / RRF tool table, or connect to the machine.

rgbLight.caption: RGB Work Light
rgbLight.enableInConfiguration: Enable RGB Work Light in Configuration to control the machine light.
rgbLight.hardwareMissing: No LED strip in the object model yet. If the board pack set nxtRGBPin (Scylla does), controls still work after enabling RGB Work Light. Otherwise check board entry / M950.
rgbLight.statusColorsHint: Colors used by the daemon for each machine state. Apply pushes to the controller; Save writes nxt-rgb-colours.g. Test forces that state via nxtRGBTest.
